# Martin ratio (Ulcer Performance Index) (`martin_ratio`)

*Category: Risk-adjusted performance · Nature: derived · Unit: ratio · Formula id: `martin_ratio@v1` · Methodology 0.1.0*

## 1. What does it measure?

Annualized return per unit of Ulcer Index.

## 2. Formula

```text
(CAGR - rf) / UlcerIndex, rf = 0
```

## 3. Required inputs

Periodic simple returns with a regular frequency.

## 4. Is higher or lower better?

Higher is better.

## 5. Plain-language interpretation

Return relative to how deep and prolonged the declines were.

## 6. Professional interpretation

Ulcer Performance Index (Martin & McCann, 1989); penalizes both depth and duration of drawdowns rather than volatility.

## 7. Assumptions

- Risk-free rate 0%.

## 8. When can it be misleading?

- Short histories with few drawdowns.

## 9. Minimum sensible data

At least 2 observations and at least one drawdown; low confidence below 3 years. (policy `ratio_standard`: Risk-adjusted ratios: at least 2 observations; low confidence below 3 years, moderate below 5 years.)

## 11. Sources

- Martin, P. G., & McCann, B. B. (1989). The Investor's Guide to Fidelity Funds. Wiley (Ulcer Index and Ulcer Performance Index).
- Bacon, C. R. (2021). Practical Risk-Adjusted Performance Measurement (2nd ed.). Wiley.

## 12. OpenFactsheet convention

Geometric CAGR over the canonical Ulcer Index.
